description: A formula is preserved downward along embeddings between nonempty models of \(T\) if and only if it is preserved downward along actual nonempty substructure inclusions between nonempty models of \(T\), at tuples from the substructure.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.downward_preserved_iff_inclusions.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (T : L.Theory) {n : ℕ} (φ : L.Formula (Fin n)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.DownwardPreserved T φ ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.DownwardInclusionPreserved T φ
